newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish police foil terror attack on London.
newsitem.headline: Danish police foil terror attack on London.

text.p: Danish police on Saturday arrested seven members of an extreme right-wing group they said planned to send letter bombs to addresses in London.
A policeman was shot and wounded during one of several raids following a tipoff from police intelligence in Germany, Detective Commander Per Larsen of Copenhagen police, told a news conference.

Larsen said that Saturday's raids, on two locations in the capital and a house in the seaside village of Nivaa some 20 km (eight miles) to the north, uncovered explosives, detonators and three letter-bombs, primed and ready to be sent.
"They were disguised as video tapes and were to be sent to addresses in London, I will not at this point say anything about the intended recipients," Larsen said.

"First indications are that an extreme right-wing group here in Denmark is being controlled from abroad, with the intention of hitting international targets," police murder squad chief Kurt Jensen said.
"We are still in full swing with our searches and would not rule out further arrests."
